text:
maya: FYI - our eu1 canary started failing after the last rollout. error rate ~5.4% on inference service, threshold is 5%. tagging SREs for quick decision @sahil @ryan
ops-bot: Deploy Bot: Canary failure detected for service=redwood-inference/eu1, release=v2.14.7, canary_error_rate=5.4%. Suggested actions: rollback to v2.14.6 OR pin traffic to stable. Approvals required: 2 SREs or ENG lead.
sahil: I skimmed logs, looks like tokenizer NPE in the new tokenizer plugin. Not seeing DB impact. I vote rollback to v2.14.6. :thumbsup:
ryan: Oncall here. I agree with rollback. Can we confirm no schema changes?
leah: No schema changes. Just model preproc. Rollback safe. +1
maya: Quick ops checklist: notify support & set status page to "degraded" until canary is green? Also will open a short postmortem ticket.
sahil: rollback command (will run after +1 from @ryan):
```
opsctl deploy rollback --cluster=eu1 --service=inference --to-version=v2.14.6 --reason="canary error > threshold"
```
Expected rollout ~3m, canary checks for 10m after.
ryan: +1, go for it.
ops-bot: Deploy Bot: Received approvals from sahil, ryan. Initiating rollback to v2.14.6 in 30s. deployment_id=deploy-1946129876-rollback
ops-bot: Deploy Bot: Rolling back... step=drain, step=deploy, step=promote
ops-bot: Deploy Bot: Rollback complete in 2m10s. New active release=v2.14.6. Post-rollback canary error_rate=0.2% (<0.5% baseline).
maya: Nice. Thanks everyone. I'll post incident note + assign follow-ups: fix tokenizer NPE, add unit for that parsing edge-case, and add a canary alert tweak to avoid noisy triggers.
leah: I pinged support to close impacted tickets and added a short blurb for customers.
sahil: I'll triage logs and push a PR for the fix branch, will include a targeted unit/regression test.
ryan: Leaving note oncall log and closing the oncall incident. Good job team. :tada:
